domain.description: The domain where the group is defined. For example: the LDAP or Active Directory domain.
domain.caption: Domain

uid.description: The unique identifier of the group. For example, for Windows events this is the security identifier (SID) of the group. Another example, pool id or desktop id that the device belongs to.
uid.caption: Unique ID

uid_numeric.description:
The uid attribute in numeric form where applicable.
Note: Producers may populate uid_numeric only in addition to uid and not as an alternative to it.
uid_numeric.caption: Numeric Unique ID

name: group
description: The Group object represents a collection or association of entities, such as users, policies, or devices. It serves as a logical grouping mechanism to organize and manage entities with similar characteristics or permissions within a system or organization, including but not limited to purposes of access control.
caption: Group
